question: So Subaru had indeed noticed that Petra had feelings for him... He thinks those feelings will fade after a while, but if they don't, I want him to properly take responsibility
answer:
Subaru isn't particularly dense, so when someone directs affection at him, he notices.
Even after Rem fell head-over-heels for Subaru, he properly realized it.
However, because he lacks self-confidence to an extreme degree, he doesn't fathom a situation where 'someone would naturally fall in love with him', and thinks that's impossible.
With Emilia, he's making appeals to get her to look his way, so his stance is working hard so that she will eventually come to like him, which makes it a little different from the others.
